claims_supported: Gross cash proceeds were approximately $272.6 million, consisting of approximately $224.6 million of private-placement cash and $48 million of trust-account proceeds after redemptions, before transaction expenses.
The $214.05 million advance-funding cash was used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP before the business-combination close.
Evernorth held approximately 473 million XRP as of October 9, 2026.

The company completed a $30 million 4.00% Convertible Senior PIK Notes issuance on October 12 to NH Investment & Securities as trustee of Kyobo AIM Corporate Finance General Private Investment Trust No. 3.

A Ripple related-party credit facility had $9.7 million borrowed as of October 7 and a $10 million limit; the filing describes 3.81% interest and repayment within five business days after closing or upon demand.
Evernorth entered a discretionary Cantor committed equity facility for up to 5,218,935 new Class A shares at 97% of VWAP, subject to registration, price, volume and ownership limits.
Coinbase was selected as the principal market for XRP fair-value/impairment accounting; BitGo Bank & Trust was the digital-asset custodian.
The prospectus describes planned XRP lending, covered calls, basis trades, DeFi lending and liquidity provision as strategies, not as proof those strategies were already operating.

principal_risks: 80.3% SPAC public-share redemptions reduced trust cash to approximately $48 million.
The $214.05 million advance cash was already deployed into XRP before closing; it is not remaining cash.
The $30 million convertible note is debt with PIK interest and potential share dilution.

Coinbase is the accounting principal market, while BitGo is custodian; conflating these roles would be incorrect.

capital_flow_interpretation.actual_capital_summary: The closing documents support approximately $272.6 million of gross cash proceeds, but $214.05 million of the private-placement cash had already been used to buy 84.365876 million XRP. Approximately $48 million came from the SPAC trust after 80.3% redemptions and $10.5 million from delayed funding at close, before fees. A separate $30 million convertible PIK note was issued on October 12. Ripple also provided two distinct short-term facilities: a $1 million Evernorth Facility (undrawn as of June 30) and a $10 million Company Facility to Pathfinder, of which $9.7 million was drawn as of October 7. The post-close repayment status of the $9.7 million draw is not disclosed. In addition, approximately 388.91 million XRP was contributed in kind, bringing the reported treasury to approximately 473 million XRP.
capital_flow_interpretation.actual_vs_announced: SBI announced a $200 million cash commitment in 2025. The SEC closing filing confirms SBI Holdings' post-close ownership but does not itemize its individual cash contribution. Aggregate private-placement proceeds must not be attributed wholly to SBI.
capital_flow_interpretation.actual_vs_optional: The Cantor equity line is an option to issue shares, not cash received. The resale registration is not a company financing. The $30 million note is debt, and the $9.7 million Ripple facility is short-term related-party borrowing.
capital_flow_interpretation.actual_vs_xrp_demand: Only the 84.365876 million XRP purchase is a disclosed cash-funded open-market acquisition. The remaining approximately 388.91 million XRP was contributed in kind. The in-kind transfers increase treasury concentration but are not equivalent to contemporaneous exchange-market buying.

data_quality.cash_vs_xrp: The $214.05 million advance cash was converted into 84.365876 million XRP before close. It is not both a cash balance and an XRP asset at the same time.
data_quality.entity_boundaries: Ripple Labs, RippleWorks Foundation, Larsen Lam Children's Remainder Trust, Arrington XRP Capital Fund LP, SBI Holdings and SBI regional SBIC companies are distinct legal entities.

data_quality.credit_facility_distinction: The $9.7 million draw is under the $10 million Company Facility to Pathfinder, not the separate $1 million Evernorth Facility. The latter was undrawn as of June 30. Do not collapse these facilities into one loan.
